🇰🇷 Government Partnership · 2025

Korea Small Business Corporation
Australia Popup Store & Buyer Consultation

📅 23–24 August 2025 📍 Strathfield, Sydney 🤝 소상공인시장진흥공단 (SEMAS)

In 2025, LCG partnered with the Korea Small Business and Market Corporation (소상공인시장진흥공단 · SEMAS) to host a popup store and buyer consultation program in Australia. Korean SMEs showcased their K-Beauty and lifestyle products directly to Australian consumers and buyers, with LCG managing all logistics, buyer coordination, and on-the-ground operations.
